tagline: Azenta provides life sciences solutions that accelerate discovery, development and commercialization of biological and chemical compounds.
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue is the principal indicator of the company's overall performance, reflecting its ability to sell sample management solutions and genomic services

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales of goods and services by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue increased 4% for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025 compared to the prior fiscal year.

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Gross profit between revenue and cost of revenue, indicating the profitability of products and services.
kpis.description: Gross profit increased 6.1% for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, reaching $270,280 thousand.

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred for research and development of new products and services.
kpis.description: Research and development expenses decreased 3.6% for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to sales, marketing, administration and general functions of the company.
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses slightly decreased 0.5% for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025.

kpis.name: Operating Loss
kpis.explanation: Negative operating result, indicating that expenses exceed operating revenue.
kpis.description: Operating loss reduced 47.7% for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, declining from $51.284 million to $26.844 million.

kpis.name: Net Income from Continuing Operations
kpis.explanation: Profit resulting from the company's principal operating activities, before discontinued operations.
kpis.description: The company recorded net income of $24.458 million from continuing operations for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, compared to a loss of $24.366 million in the prior year.
kpis.signal: Return to profitability of core operations.

kpis.name: Number of Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company on a full-time, part-time and other contract basis.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 3,000 full-time, part-time and contract workers worldwide.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €2.06 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Divestiture of Semiconductor Automation Division
kpis.explanation: Sale of a major business unit to focus on life sciences segments.
kpis.description: The semiconductor automation division was sold for $2.9 billion to Thomas H. Lee Partners, L.P. in February 2022.

kpis.name: Disposition of B Medical Systems as Discontinued Operation
kpis.explanation: Classification of a business unit as held for sale and discontinued operation as part of a strategic refocus.
kpis.description: B Medical Systems, a global manufacturer and distributor of medical refrigeration devices based in Luxembourg, was classified as held for sale and a discontinued operation during the first quarter of fiscal year 2025. This strategic action is intended to simplify the portfolio and enable management to focus on revenue growth and profitability of core operations.

risks.title: Prolonged Economic Slowdown
risks.score_rationale: A prolonged economic slowdown, reductions in government funding for scientific research, increases in interest rates or other macroeconomic pressures could reduce customer purchases, impacting sales and cash flows

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the provided 10-K.
